summary: Nexus Storage Manager - first-run full-stack test. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass (auth, dashboard, users, storages CRUD, access enforcement, secret redaction). Frontend: end-to-end admin flow verified via Playwright (login, dashboard, sidebar nav, add S3, add Samba w/ type toggle, edit, add user, manage-access, logout, non-admin sidebar visibility, /storages and /users redirected to /files for regular users, file browser shows only assigned storage). Cleanup performed. Test-connection button returns graceful failure with fake creds (expected).

minor.issue: Accepts empty config without validating required S3/Samba fields (e.g. bucket, host); errors surface only later on test/list operations.
Returns 200 with {status: deleted} even when id does not exist (no 404 for unknown storages).
Same: returns 200 for non-existent user; also no ObjectId format validation (invalid id will 500 from ObjectId(...)).
Type mismatch between existing storage type and body.type is not rejected (allows converting s3<->samba which corrupts config).
No timeout on backend.test() - a bad Samba host can hang the request indefinitely.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Signed in'/'Storage deleted' success toast is positioned in the top-right and overlaps/covers the 'Add Storage' primary button (see screenshot). Clicks pass through only via JS dispatch. Real users may find the button visually obscured for ~3s after every toast.

Permission badge renders only the first letter (`s.permission?.[0]`) which shows 'r' or 'w' in a tiny 10px opacity-60 font - not obvious/readable. Consider full-word badge (READ/WRITE) as described in the PRD.

issues: Success toast in top-right occludes the Add Storage button (z-index/positioning collision).

action_items: Reposition the success toast so it does not overlap the top-right primary action button (Add Storage / Add User).
Add Pydantic validation for storage.config required fields per type (s3: bucket/access_key/secret_key; samba: host/share).
Return 404 for DELETE/PUT storage/user with unknown or malformed ObjectId; wrap ObjectId() in try/except.
Reject PUT /api/storages/{id} when body.type differs from stored type (or explicitly document conversion).
Add a request timeout to backend.test() so failed connection tests do not hang the API worker.
(Optional) Show full-word READ/WRITE permission badge in File Browser storage switcher.
critical_code_review_comments: crypto_util.py derives Fernet key from JWT_SECRET - rotating JWT_SECRET will silently break decryption of all stored S3 secret_keys / Samba passwords. Recommend a dedicated STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY env var.

server.py imports crypto_util/storage_backends as top-level modules (no package). Works because backend is launched from /app/backend, but would break under a different working directory - consider a proper package or relative imports.
test_config / test_saved use bare `except Exception` and echo str(e) to the client - could leak stacktraces/AWS internals in the response message. Sanitize error messages.
S3Backend.test() calls head_bucket without a client-level connect_timeout / read_timeout via BotoConfig; slow/bad endpoints can block. Configure short timeouts.
user_permission_for() returns 'write' for admin - correct - but implicitly grants admin access to every storage even if not listed; behavior is by design but should be documented.
delete_storage does not verify ObjectId format; malformed id string throws bson error -> uncaught 500.
test_credentials: admin@example.com / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Test users created ad-hoc via API/UI and cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. All TEST_* storages and test_ui_* users were created and deleted within the test run. Admin remains intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; tests must be self-contained per class (do NOT share state across classes via class attributes). Backend URL is read from frontend/.env (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Admin login lands at `/` (not `/dashboard`) - use element wait (`nav-dashboard`) instead of URL wait. Storage add-storage button in top-right can be blocked by success toast; prefer JS dispatch (page.evaluate(el.click())) or wait ~4s after login before clicking. Modal name field testid is `storage-name-input` (not just any input in the dialog). Delete confirmation uses native `confirm()`, register a `page.once('dialog', d.accept())` before each delete click. Access dialog checkboxes: `access-{storage_id}-read` / `access-{storage_id}-write`. Regular users are correctly redirected from /storages and /users to /files.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocker bugs; issues listed are quality/UX items.
